releaseNotes:
Hubble 1.3.1

Hubble 1.3.1: button layout editing and feedback defaults

Move buttons with Command-drag, Shift-select multiple buttons, and copy, cut, or paste with Command-C, Command-X, and Command-V. The compact drag preview keeps the layout readable.

View and edit button actions below the layout with the same field behavior as the main matrix. Text and numeric values stay directly editable, and opening the action editor keeps the buttons at their existing size. Refresh the layout or show and hide the editor from its controls.

Enable feedback by default for new actions in each module's settings. Existing actions and individual feedback choices are preserved.

Install or reinstall the Companion plugin from Module Connections or Button Layout, with its version shown beside the button. The setup guide now puts installation, permissions, and required settings first.
